newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge up to end at 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge up to end at 21 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed slightly firmer in active trade and abundant money supply, dealers said on Monday.
Overnight rates finished at 21.00 percent, compared with 20.375/21.375 at the opening and 20.875/21.00 percent at Wednesday's close.
"Most banks filled their reserves ahead of the long (May Day) weekend," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
He added that with overnight rates around 21 percent excess funds are unlikely to be soaked up by the central bank's reverse repo facility.
The central bank's one-week reverse repo rate, reduced on April 26 by 25 basis points, stands at 20.75 percent.
